headers.//: The two models are 27.3 MB and 18.2 MB. They were cached for a single day WITH must-revalidate, so a returning visitor paid for them again on any visit past that day -- which is a large part of 'lento'. stale-while-revalidate serves the cached copy INSTANTLY and refreshes it in the background, so after the first load nobody waits for the model again, and a re-exported model still reaches everyone on their next visit. The filenames are not content-hashed, so `immutable` is deliberately NOT used: it would strand a corrected model in caches for a year.
The anatomy index is 1.3 MB of JSON with the same lifecycle as the models: regenerated only when the model is.
Vite content-hashes everything under /assets, so a changed file is a changed URL and these can be cached forever.
